sources.title: Video tutorial.webm
sources.speech_characteristics: English instructional narration with a strong accent; Whisper tiny labels language yo but produces usable English segments.

sources.title: Demo Video Tutorial.webm
sources.speech_characteristics: Clear English narration over slides and screen recordings; short pauses and mostly lexical instructional content.

sources.title: Course Overview (6.002x).webm
sources.speech_characteristics: Continuous English university lecture narration over an animated course-map slide; dense technical vocabulary.

decision.recommendation: Ship the 54-parameter text-only AUTO router while retaining Visual, Speech, and Hybrid overrides. AUTO matches oracle explicit-mode R@5 on the frozen held-out set. Require a ready transcript for speech-routed searches and treat the next 30-60 minute personal-video acceptance run as the blocker before v1.0.
